cases.title: Dominant inversion in C major
cases.explanation: The middle G-major sonority has B in the bass: first inversion. This is a sonority/inversion check, not an automatic functional or cadence judgment.

cases.title: Parallel fifths across two voices
cases.explanation: All three successive voice pairs preserve a perfect fifth in similar motion. Whether to revise them depends on the intended style.

cases.title: Pickup, chromatic pitch and carried tie
cases.explanation: The pickup remains written measure 0, the explicit C-sharp is preserved, and the tied final D lasts six quarter notes across written measures 3–4.
